title: GYATT
blurb: Escaped from streaming chat, got absorbed into the Gen Alpha lexicon, and is now impossible to say in front of anyone under sixteen without consequences. Gyatt began as a drawn-out contraction of an exclamation of astonishment before settling into its current role as a reaction to something startling. It is load-bearing brainrot vocabulary, sitting alongside rizz and sigma in the same crowded sentence. Deploy the button ironically, anthropologically, or at real reputational risk. Adults who use it correctly are somehow more alarming than the adults who get it wrong.
origin: From streamer slang, absorbed into the Gen Alpha brainrot canon.
